# Gramlot JavaScript Server 0.2.15 — Nested hosted and offline galleries

Node/Bun and the serverless exporter preserve the numbered gallery hierarchy,
nested routes, folder indexes and companions. The gallery uses the shared tree,
FramePage/IndexPage and retained iframe panels. Window Logic imports share the
existing runtime; Worker execution stays separate.

The packages use the coordinated core and examples updates. Database selectors,
Genropy integration experiments and editor ports are excluded.
